## Linked Issue

Refs #2295

Related original inputs: [Graph4410](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/pull/4410), [Snapshot4408](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/pull/4408), [StorageConflict4407](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/pull/4407). Original issues [2474](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2474) and [2304](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2304) stay open.

## Scope Summary

Independent three-leaf source composition on exact base `b302f58a9aaee9f2399d9274157a478f3c2f78fb`. Accept only Graph `74b75c0d1104105bf6124ae46c84e5f3d8a60387`, Snapshot `625db2655aa61a01f071618ddfab683de79dc812`, and repaired StorageConflict `44b94b5f717aeaae5285426eb7bbd2a98b2e67af`. The user supplied independent finite SOURCE acceptance for these inputs; the combined candidate's independent SOURCE review remains pending.

Exact 332 disjoint input paths, nine production files and 323 original ordinary evidence/naming/WIP files. All modes, blobs and base preimages verified; all other base entries unchanged. Source composition commit `71175d0979dcfc590025b67d37fcafbe6f66c594` has the exact base as its sole parent, with no donor history. Own WIP/check evidence follows. No overlap with draft4420 production scope and no eight-control composition imported. All-state audit checked 1,346 PRs and complete rosters of 27 exact-base PRs; no existing combined candidate.

Real clean UI973 alias `41a127611fa3db054b7d5bca25aeb101f2401ef6` through the unchanged complete application producer. Graph remains preflight only; Snapshot has no production host import; storage cancel/restore remain disabled. The repaired pagination named re-export obeys the original README boundary. No host, command, authority, grant or receipt invented. CSS is unbuilt and consumer acceptance incomplete.

## Notes For Reviewers

Handoff: `artifacts/article-editor/three-leaf-graph-snapshot-storage-wip.md`. Exact identities, source map, duplicate audit, actual dependency reuse and complete command/raw output sidecars are ordinary evidence, not frozen authority/receipts or qualification. Existing genuine dependencies were reused; no tool/package install, product setup, replacement harness, security/permission change or configuration reduction. Installed UI root manifest/lock differences are disclosed in the exact retained diff and are not dependency-byte qualification. Actual UI source is clean973. Source alias does not build product CSS.

Graph retains the original unavailable relation projection, bounded scalar/depth/budget admission and cancellation catch. It supplies no runtime provider or same-count linearizability guarantee; arbitrary Count/indexer callbacks may still block/allocate. Snapshot preserves the genuine prepared restore plan and sole ratio owner; the real group still needs readPrepared and joint commit/discard. Storage retains disabled cancel/restore and exact intent/request/context/reference identity. Unknown is not zero and cancel is not settled. No consumer host or authority invented.

FsusBlog/exact UI973 design-conformance Skills applied as source-boundary guidance. Blog owns task/product composition. Exact source preserves hierarchy, states, public primitives, themes/locales/viewports, focus/overflow and reduced-motion intent; no redesign, shared token/component/geometry change or private wrapper. Formal classification, acceptance, receipts and rendered evidence remain held under the user's explicit scope. UI checkboxes remain unchecked. Static parsing loads compiler tools only, never product/helper modules.

The formatter checkbox deliberately stays unchecked: full original lint invocation failed for missing tools and no actual frontend lint success is claimed. Metadata FAIL must remain visible; no checkbox, false receipt, naming/binding artifact or frozen change is invented to pass. API/AEDS/database/external-contract and long-term docs updates are reviewed n/a: no cross-stack wire, schema, public design authority or live data changes. Ordinary WIP documents scope/limits; no current document lifecycle entry or generated index changed. Mechanical/blame/performance/generated fields are n/a for this behavior-source composition.

All runtime, tests, collection/list/discovery, setup, product/helper module execution, browser/mount, native/worker/kernel, DB, network-security/privacy, receipt/race/backuprestore/IME, frozen and qualification work remains HOLD/UNRUN. No Ready, merge, close, auto-merge, package publication or release. Original source acceptance does not qualify this combination. If upload is refused, stop without an alternate upload route.
